description: Validates that the recently built v2 enrichment modules (temporal_stability_enrichment_v2.py, tool_description_safety_enrichment_v2.py, permission_scope_enrichment_v2.py) produce more than 3 distinct score values when exercised against a synthetic corpus of 34 fingerprints. Queries mcp_signal_enrichments table via write_service to count distinct score values per signal_type. If any signal still has <=3 distinct values, report which module needs review. This is a diagnostic/validation script, not a build task.
